title: indicadores-mx data file
description: Canonical store of one series in the repository: data/<series>.json, one observation per line, sorted by date. Values are the decimal text published, without spaces or percent signs. The API in /v1 is generated from these files.

dofRef.description: A DOF note: publication date and SIDOF codNota.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (daily and step series) or YYYY-MM (monthly series).

value.description: Decimal text as published (no sign, spaces or percent).

checked.description: The value was compared with the text of its DOF note and matched.

term_days.description: TIIE only: the term the DOF note states when Banco de México shortened or extended the nominal one because the maturity fell on a holiday (for example 29 instead of 28).
